stem_book: In the system shown, m₁ hangs from one end of a string passing over a fixed pulley; the other end of that string carries a light movable pulley. A second string, tied to the floor, passes over the movable pulley and carries m₂ at its other end. Pulleys are massless and frictionless and the strings are inextensible. The tension in the string connected to m₂ equals (a) 3m₁m₂g/(m₁+4m₂) (b) m₁m₂g/(m₁+4m₂) (c) 4m₁m₂g/(m₁+4m₂) (d) 5m₁m₂g/(m₁+4m₂)
